wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.notes: General Spanish spelling frequency, not sense-specific or Mexico-specific. Zipf3.5 is approximately3.16 occurrences per million. Data reflects historical mixed corpora, not a current exhaustive lexicon. Complete pinned README retains underlying acknowledgments and freely available SUBTLEX credits.

wiktionary.author: Wiktionary contributors
wiktionary.extractor: Wiktextract, hosted by Kaikki; exact extractor revision for this Spanish-edition artifact is not stated on its download listing.
wiktionary.modifications: Retain accepted4–7letter Spanish entries with Zipf>=3.5; extract only POS/title/tags/categories/senses, remove quotations/examples/translations/media, retain raw-line SHA256. No postprocessed merged Kaikki data is used.
wiktionary.limitations: Spanish-edition extraction is a work in progress. Missing labels, incomplete senses and imperfect grammar/commonness classification remain possible. Word-level source/history links use https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/<word> and its history; exact source revisions are not provided in the raw artifact.

review.method: Independent model scan of all provisional candidates, full-sense checks for flagged entries, source-label filtering and explicit root review decisions. Not human/native certification. Commonness/suitability overrides are judgments, not measured sense frequencies.

grammarPolicy: Require documented independent, nonplural base-word senses. Exclude conjugated-only forms, gerund/participle-only forms, adjective agreement-only forms and plural-only noun/pronoun senses. Keep ordinary independent noun/adjective senses and lexicalized uninflected adverbs/interjections/function words; singular feminine noun meanings are not excluded merely for grammatical gender. Source labels and reviewed decisions exclude unsuitable archaic/rare/offensive/regional senses. No suffix-only heuristic, no count cap, no translation requirement.
remainingGap: Frequency is attached to spellings, not senses; selected sense commonness and Mexican suitability cannot be certified exhaustively.190 frequency-qualified accepted forms have no retained Spanish-edition lexical entry and do not qualify automatically.

supplementalNounEvidence.source: Spanish noun entries in the English-language Wiktionary definition API; exact responses and SHA256 retained. Generator validates the noun part of speech and reviewed definition text before choosing these ordinary senses. No new teaching records.
